versions.changelog: Improved skill wording to explain inline read / file handling to better fit with openclaw permissioning, support non-image LLMs and explain the short-lived URL approach for large/binary files.

Returning large files and/or binary files in tool calls, causes a context explosion.
- Updated usage instructions for handling binary files and screenshots:
  - Clarified never to pull binary data directly into context; use short-lived download URLs for large files and images.
  - Documented the inline read cap (1MB) with guidance for fallback to download URLs.
- Improved instructions about remote vs. local actions, especially to avoid confusion with SSH.
- Minor clarification in permission/denied action behavior—only retry on user request.

Tool calls in openclaw do not consider the fallback imageModel setting which causes the screenshot functions to fail. 
- now includes instructions for text-only models to handle screenshots by saving to disk and fetching the file for image processing.

Greatly reduced the number of tools exposed to openclaw - this was causing issues with smaller models as well as ambiguity of tool names which was causing confusion. This is a major revamp from the earlier version.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md for clarity and conciseness.
- Clarified the separation between remote and local actions.
- Emphasized the use of new remote_* tools with action parameters for all remote operations.
- Added more explicit instructions on tool usage, strategy, and security policies.
- Updated SKILL.md and bundle contents to explain the auth and security built in.
